title: Hypher Launch
logline: For builders who switch between Claude Code and Codex on one repo: stop re-explaining your project. The next agent starts from one note. Join the pilot at hypher.app.

scenes.intent: The pain: you are typing your project's context into yet another agent, again.

text.headline: Every agent starts from zero.

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. JOIN IN (carry up, 10%, layers from writeback): headline on screen from frame 0, arriving with the wave. Both panes, save-term (Claude Code) and codex-term (Codex CLI, idle: resume's pane in its slot), are on screen at full opacity from frame 0 and move by translate only (y 32 → 0, responsive), travelling up with the carry. 0.4: caption fades. 0.7 → go: the idle Codex prompt's caret (codex-caret, sage) blinks two whole periods, ending solid, so the pane visibly waits for the command. b1 (0.55): m.type("save-cmd", { cps: 20 }) to ~1.15 (the box fades in at b1, then the text types). b2 (1.2): save-out rises, ease expressive (the one moment: saved). Camera: frame 0 at 1.02 on the headline's left edge, easing back to 1 (inOut) from 0.3 to go: the hold's ambient life, at rest on the identity before the command moves, so the match cut lines both panes up pixel for pixel (a push would end 2% in, and both panes would jump at the cut). go (2.7): JOIN OUT (match v2): save-cmd tweens x 0 → 360 over the last 0.6s on t², { type: "bezier", p: [1/3, 0, 2/3, 1/3] }, ending at end, so it is fastest on the last frame (v ≈ 1200 px/s); save-echo, the command's grey trace at the prompt column, stays hidden while the box crosses it (no doubled string) and fades in at instant once the box's left edge has cleared its right edge (end − 0.1: the box is 250 px along, the echo ~245 wide). Nothing else moves; the caption stays put (it is paired).
